segments.text: [soft, slow, warm voice] [softly] Lie down and arrange the body for twenty minutes of unhurried rest. Imagine a warm cabin while snow gathers quietly outside.
[soft, slow, warm voice] [soft blanket fabric rustling] Feel the whole body beneath its coverings. Nothing needs to be held up. The roof, walls, and earth are doing the work.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Right thumb... first finger... second... third... fourth... palm... back of hand... wrist. Snow softens every edge.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Right lower arm... elbow... upper arm... shoulder... armpit... right ribs... waist... hip.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Right thigh... knee... shin... calf... ankle... heel... sole... top of foot... big toe through little toe.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Left thumb... first finger... second... third... fourth... palm... back of hand... wrist.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Left lower arm... elbow... upper arm... shoulder... armpit... left ribs... waist... hip.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Left thigh... knee... shin... calf... ankle... heel... sole... top of foot... big toe through little toe.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Backs of both legs... buttocks... tailbone... lower back... middle back... upper back... shoulder blades... back of neck.
[soft, slow, warm voice] [gentle stove fire crackling] Lower belly... navel... upper belly... ribs... heart area... collarbones... throat. The cabin stove glows without needing attention.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Chin... jaw muscles... lower lip... upper lip... corners of mouth... teeth... gums... tongue lying loose in the floor of the mouth.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Inner cheeks... outer cheeks... nose... nostrils... bridge of nose... skin beneath the eyes.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Right eye... left eye... both eyelids... muscles around the eyes... eyebrows... the soft space between them.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Forehead smoothing... temples... ears... back of skull... top of head... entire scalp. Let the face finish its last conversation.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Feel the entire right side... entire left side... both sides together... back body... front body... complete body.
[soft, slow, warm voice] [reassuringly] You may feel heavy, light, restless, or nearly asleep. The snow does not require a particular kind of quiet.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Rest as the whole cabin, not one room at a time. Breath moves softly through the warm interior.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Let several long moments pass with the complete body known at once.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Begin hearing the real room. Feel temperature, coverings, floor, and the shape of the body returning.
[soft, slow, warm voice] [softly] Move fingers and toes, roll the head gently, and stretch if desired. Open your eyes as snowlight reaches the windows.
